title: Same lipstick: one small change in finish
script: 00–02s: actual close-up of hand applying lipstick. 02–05s: same lips, dabbing gloss at center. 05–09s: two finishes shown under the same light. Keep the product and model consistent.
caption: Same lipstick, two different finishes. Which would you wear? An illustration of technique, not product shade accuracy.
